q: Has the news of the overwhelming
(Qiyaamah is described as “the overwhelming thing” because its hardship and severity will overpower every person.)
v.s: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
v.c: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺?

q: Many faces on that day will be looking down
v.s: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
v.c: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast,

q: He who suffered a great deal and who endured many difficulties
(thinking that he was pleasing Allaah, but his beliefs and actions did not conform with the decrees of Allaah).
v.s: Working [hard] and exhausted.
v.c: ˹totally˺ overburdened, exhausted,

q: He shall enter the blazing fire...
v.s: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
v.c: burning in a scorching Fire,

m: They will be given to drink
q: ...where he will be given water to drink from boiling springs.
v.s: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
v.c: left to drink from a scalding spring.

v.s: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
v.c: They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub,

v.s: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
v.c: neither nourishing nor satisfying hunger.

q: Many faces on that day will be resplendent
v.s: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
v.c: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss,

q: shall be pleased with their efforts
(in this world because their efforts earned them entry)...
v.s: With their effort [they are] satisfied
v.c: ˹fully˺ pleased with their striving,

v.s: In an elevated garden,
v.c: in an elevated Garden,

q: ...where they shall not hear futile talk.

(Jannah shall have nothing unpleasant. Neither will one see anything unpleasant, nor hear anything unpleasant. There will be no noise and shouting in Jannah, nor any talk that is futile and therefore unpleasant.)
v.s: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
v.c: where no idle talk will be heard.

v.s: Within it is a flowing spring.
v.c: In it will be a running spring,

v.s: Within it are couches raised high
v.c: along with thrones raised high,

v.s: And cups put in place
v.c: and cups set at hand,

v.s: And cushions lined up
v.c: and ˹fine˺ cushions lined up,

v.s: And carpets spread around.
v.c: and ˹splendid˺ carpets spread out.

q: (Allaah is Most Capable of creating Jahannam with all its misery as well as Jannah with all its bounties, just as He created many magnificent things in this world. Encouraging people to look around to see Allaah's great creative powers, Allaah says,)
not looked at the camel and seen how it was created
(perfectly, adapted to the harsh climate of the desert with so many unique features, qualities and capabilities)?
v.s: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
v.c: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created;

q: at the sky, how it was raised
v.s: And at the sky - how it is raised?
v.c: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺;

q: at the mountains, how they were placed firmly
(into the earth with their bulk underground)?
v.s: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
v.c: and the mountains—how they were firmly set up;

q: at the earth, how it was spread out
(with large tracts of land that seem flat despite the spherical shape of the earth)?
v.s: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
v.c: and the earth—how it was levelled out?

q: (to encourage people to accept and sincerely practise Islaam),
v.s: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
v.c: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind.

q: You have not been appointed as a warder
v.s: You are not over them a controller.
v.c: You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺.

q: However, the one who turns away
v.s: However, he who turns away and disbelieves
v.c: But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief,

q: Allaah shall punish him most severely.
v.s: Then God will punish him with the greatest punishment.
v.c: then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment.

v.s: Indeed, to Us is their return.
v.c: Surely to Us is their return,

q: Thereafter, it is Our responsibility to take their reckoning
(make them account for all their) Deeds in this world).
v.s: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
v.c: then surely with Us is their reckoning.
